# LIF_Neuron_Model

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neuron model that accumulates membrane potential and emits a spike when threshold is exceeded. This is the fundamental computational unit in neuromorphic chips, and its dynamics directly influence how TCC graph computations are encoded and processed.
